title: A Universal Reproducing Kernel Hilbert Space from Polynomial Alignment and IMQ Distance
abstract: arXiv:2605.03262v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Inverse-multiquadric (IMQ) kernel sections decay at infinity. Can polynomial alignment add persistent directional responses while preserving universal approximation? The \yat{} (Yat) kernel answers this question by multiplying IMQ distance by a biased squared inner product. With shared positive bias and regularization, its RKHS continuously contains the IMQ RKHS and is universal on every compact domain. Alignment strictly enlarges the global function space: Yat sections retain a quadratic directional trace at infinity. We quantify a second distinction through high-dimensional activation covariance. For a fixed number of orthogonal unit centers and fixed kernel parameters, isotropic Gaussian inputs yield a rank-one rescaled limiting covariance for IMQ and a full-rank limit for Yat. translated_title: 基于多项式对齐与逆多重二次（IMQ）距离的普适再生核希尔伯特空间
translated_abstract: 逆多重二次核（IMQ）的核截面在无穷远处会衰减。多项式对齐能否在保持普适逼近能力的同时添加持久的方向性响应？Yat核通过将IMQ距离与一个带偏置的平方内积相乘来回答这个问题。在共享的正偏置和正则化条件下，其再生核希尔伯特空间（RKHS）连续包含IMQ的RKHS，并且在每个紧域上都是普适的。对齐严格地扩大了全局函数空间：Yat截面在无穷远处保留了二次方向性迹。我们通过高维激活协方差量化了第二个区别。对于固定数量的正交单位中心和固定的核参数，各向同性高斯输入使IMQ产生秩一重缩放的极限协方差，而Yat则产生满秩的极限协方差。在半径√d的球面上，两个极限均为满秩，从而将共享的输入范数波动分离出来，解释了高斯坍缩机制。
tldr: 本文提出Yat核，通过将IMQ距离与带偏置的平方内积（多项式对齐）相乘，构建了一个在每个紧域上普适且严格扩展IMQ函数空间的再生核希尔伯特空间，并证明其高维激活协方差在高斯输入下保持满秩。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the Yat kernel, which multiplies IMQ distance by a biased squared inner product to construct a universally approximating RKHS that strictly enlarges the IMQ function space, while its activation covariance remains full-rank under high-dimensional Gaussian inputs.
